setup.rule: Points = difficulty points + speed bonus (up to 50%) + streak bonus (up to 50%). One ×2 joker.

charades.yourTurnBody: Only your phone shows the word. Act it out without a single word!

charades.otherTeam: The other team is playing; if they skip a word, you can steal it.
charades.stealHint: The other team can steal a skipped word with one guess.
charades.secretOnPhone: The word is only on the actor's phone
charades.rulesBody: One player holds the phone and acts out the word without speaking. The team has 60 seconds to guess as many words as possible.
charades.rulesPoints: Easy = 100 · Medium = 200 · Hard = 300 · only 3 skips per turn · the other team can steal a skipped word for half points
charades.noMiming: No talking, no spelling letters with your hands
